items.title: Prato: Arroz branco cozido + Atum em água (lata) + Pepino
items.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative meal photograph for a nutrition recipe catalog. Primary request: a realistic appetizing serving containing ONLY these named catalog foods (names in Brazilian Portuguese): Arroz branco cozido; Atum em água (lata); Pepino. Arrange the three foods in adjacent sections in a white ceramic shallow bowl. Remove fruit peels, pits or cores that would not be eaten; do not add ingredient props beside the serving. Variety details when named: batata baroa is yellow arracacha (mandioquinha), not fibrous cassava; cuscuz marroquino is fine fluffy wheat couscous, not large pearl couscous; edamame is cooked shelled green soybeans, no inedible pods; feijao means the named bean variety, not lentils or chickpeas. Frango coxa sem pele is skinless roasted thigh muscle: serve small irregular shredded fibrous pieces with matte beige flesh and very light browning on a few tips. No intact drumsticks or whole thighs, no glossy orange-brown surface sheets or crust, no skin layered over the meat. Style: realistic editorial food photography with natural food textures.
